usageNotes: Use this to modify an existing SDN controller object's configuration (e.g. updating BGP peers, ASN, or IS-IS parameters); the controller must already exist (create it first with POST /cluster/sdn/controllers). Requires the SDN.Allocate privilege on /sdn/controllers. Changes are staged in the cluster SDN config and must be applied via POST /cluster/sdn (reload) before they take effect on nodes.

examples.summary: Update an EVPN BGP controller to add a new peer and enable eBGP multipath relaxation

tips: Use the 'digest' param to guard against concurrent edits — fetch the current digest from GET /cluster/sdn/controllers/{controller} and pass it here.
The 'delete' param accepts a comma-separated list of property names (pve-configid-list format) to unset optional fields rather than setting them to a blank value.
After any SDN controller update, always call POST /cluster/sdn to push the staged config to all cluster nodes; without the reload, network changes are not applied.
For IS-IS controllers, 'isis-net' must follow the NSAP NET format (e.g. '49.0001.0100.1001.0001.00') and be unique per node in the IS-IS domain.
BGP mode 'auto' selects eBGP when a BGP controller is present, otherwise falls back to iBGP — use explicit 'external' or 'internal' to avoid ambiguity in mixed topologies.
